# FDG9012

> DO NOT require users of aggregate components to do anything besides writing code in common scenarios. For example, users should not have to configure components in the configuration file, generate any resource files, and so on.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.1.3 Aggregate Component Guidelines.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: whether common scenarios need configuration files or generated resource files is outside the code.
